text: あそこで　パパも　はたらいてるわ

structure.jp: パパも　はたらいてるわ

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on now or is done regularly; てる is the short spoken form. はたらいてる = 'works (there)'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, womanly way to add feeling. はたらいてるわ = 'he works there, you know'.
